schema_documentation:
| key | type | presence | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `source` | str | 100.0% | `"{poet name}.txt"`; verified `source == category + '.txt'` for all 2,796 records - fully redundant |
| `category` | str | 100.0% | poet's full name, 249 distinct values (e.g. `Άκανθος`, `Cendrier Paul`) |
| `index` | int | 100.0% | per-poet poem counter 0-37, not a global ID |
| `text` | str | 100.0% | the whole poem: line 1 = poem title, then verse lines, then usually TWO trailer lines: book title, then `", Publisher, Year"` |
semantic_meaning: 2,796 contemporary Greek free-verse poems from 249 named poets, each record = title + poem body + a two-line publication trailer.
